footer_tagline: Course reviews by students, for students
search_placeholder: Search by course code, name or instructor…
search_empty_hint: Search by course code (e.g. BBM 342), course name or instructor name.
home_intro: Reviews from students who took the courses. Every review belongs to a course, an instructor and a term.
criterion_instructorClarity_hint: How clearly does the instructor explain?
criterion_instructorExpertise_hint: How well does the instructor know the subject?
suggest_course_edit: Wrong course info? Suggest a fix
no_instructors_yet: No instructors yet. You can add one when writing the first review.
few_reviews_warning: Only a few reviews so far; results may be misleading.
instructor_criteria_all_hint: This course has several instructors. Pick one above to see their ratings separately.
review_saved_pending: Your review was saved. The instructor you added will appear after admin approval.
field_attempts: How many times did you take it?
field_class_average_hint: Approximate class average that term, out of 100
field_comment_placeholder: What would you tell someone choosing this course? Which term, how to study, what the exams are like…
form_when_whom: When and from whom did you take it?
form_instructor_not_listed: Not listed, add a new instructor
form_new_instructor_note: The new instructor appears after admin approval. Your review is saved and published once the instructor is approved.
form_optional_hint: All optional, but very helpful for others.
profanity_live_warning: Inappropriate wording: {words}. This cannot be submitted.
rules_ban_warning: Users who post insulting content are permanently banned and all their content is deleted. Criticise the course and the teaching, not the person.
rules_anonymity_note: Your review is shown as "Anonymous student". Do not include details that could identify you.
error_future_term: This term has not started yet.
error_duplicate_review: You already reviewed this course, instructor and term. You can edit that review.
error_form: Please fix the errors in the form.
login_intro: Sign in with your university e-mail ({domains}) to write reviews. No password: we will send a 6-digit code.
login_error_tagged: Enter your address as is, without "+" tags (e.g. name.surname@hacettepe.edu.tr).
login_error_banned: This account has been permanently banned for violating the rules.
login_error_rate_limited: Too many codes requested. Please try again in an hour.
login_error_mail: The e-mail could not be sent. Please try again later.
login_mail_body: Your sign-in code is below. It is valid for 10 minutes. If you did not request it, you can ignore this e-mail.
privacy_box_title: We do not store your e-mail address
privacy_box_body: Your address is only used to send the code. Only an irreversible hash is stored, and your reviews appear as "Anonymous student".
verify_intro: We sent a 6-digit code to your e-mail. It is valid for 10 minutes.
verify_spam_hint: No code? Check your spam folder.
account_privacy_note: Your account is stored as an irreversible hash of your e-mail, not the address itself. Your reviews appear as "Anonymous student".
my_reviews_empty: You have not written any reviews yet.
delete_account_body: Your account and all your reviews are permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete_account_confirm: Delete your account and all your reviews?
instructor_page_note: Instructors are not rated on their own. Reviews live on each course page.
suggest_course_intro: Your suggestion goes live after admin approval.
suggestion_thanks: Thanks! Your suggestion was sent for approval.
suggest_new_course_intro: Suggest a course that is missing. It is added after admin approval.
course_already_exists: A course with this code already exists.
admin_reports_intro: Reported and hidden reviews. A ban deletes all of the user's content and blacklists their e-mail.
admin_ban_confirm: Ban this user? All of their content will be deleted.
admin_pending_intro: Instructors added by users. Merge if the person already exists.
admin_reject_confirm: Delete this instructor and their reviews?
admin_code_conflict: This code is used by another course.
admin_equivalents_intro: Link courses whose code changed with a curriculum update. Both keep their own page and link to each other.
admin_import_intro: Upload a CSV file or paste its contents. The first row must be a header. Courses with the same code are updated, instructors with the same name are not duplicated.
legal_draft_note: This text is a draft and should be legally reviewed before launch.
